line: Launch film for Tidy, a fictional app: one buried cursor snaps hundreds of windows back into place.
line_cn: 虚构 app Tidy 的发布片：被埋掉的光标一键把几百个窗口归位。

motion.cuts: one-take UI flythrough or snap zoom

camera.move: Locked extreme close-up on a tiny UI element
camera.expresses: Intimacy, one thing alive on a screen
camera.serves: a single action; a thought forming; a quiet status

camera.move: Continuous pull-back, keyed per bar in log space
camera.expresses: Accumulation, scale growing out of one point
camera.serves: spreading load; a network growing; a team joining
a decision; the instant before a commit; a bug found

camera.expresses: Cause and effect seen at once
camera.serves: a sync completing; a deploy landing everywhere

camera.move: Dive into a small UI element (log-zoom) + match cut
camera.serves: a counter that matters; a log line; a setting

camera.move: Half-second inserts expanding from their source
Near-locked frame while an object turns and light sweeps
camera.serves: a reveal; a new version; a feature name

camera.move: Slow lateral track across a UI plane

camera.serves: before/after; a loop closed; an echo

transitions: Transitions = UI expand / collapse: every shot change is an interface element expanding into the frame or the frame collapsing into an element.
labels: OFL faces: Inter (UI, captions, headlines; variable weight), Inter Tight 600 for giant numbers (tracking around −4.5 %), JetBrains Mono for labels, filenames and status text (wide tracking in small-caps labels).
One line per screen for headlines. The big number gets its own screen and no caption over it: the number is the message.

Captions are a UI component: a bottom-centre toast (dark translucent pill, 1 px light border, soft shadow, Inter 500 around 40 px, a small accent "speaking" dot). It enters with a small rise + fade in ~0.16 s and can turn more opaque over busy frames. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
Typed text is its own subtitle: text the cursor types in frame is not burned twice (it goes only into the .srt).
motion: 24 fps on ones, no stepping, no boil: this is precision, not craft.
Everything lands on the grid and on the beat. Moves start a beat early and land on it. Easing is fast-out with one small overshoot (back, s ≈ 1.3) and an immediate settle. No floaty sine drift.
Spawns are short and typed (drop + bounce, fling, slide-in, pop; 0.2–0.3 s), one motion per element type. Tension can be a tremble of a few px.
Flights follow curved paths with overshoot along the final tangent; same-type elements bend the same way and never cross.

native_moves.name: Generated accumulation
native_moves.does: UI spawned by rule, faster and faster, hundreds of items; you don't draw the mess, you generate it.
native_moves.fits: unread tickets piling up; cloud costs creeping; a dependency tree exploding.

native_moves.name: The snap grid
native_moves.does: A whole promise in one motion: everything flies into a grid in one beat; the grid stays invisible until then.
native_moves.fits: a CMS publishing to every channel; a scheduler filling a week; an audit turning green.

native_moves.name: The living element
native_moves.does: The cursor (or the product's smallest live element) is the protagonist and the brand mark.
native_moves.fits: a search box that grows ambitious; a progress ring that refuses to finish; a status dot.

native_moves.name: Freeze
native_moves.does: Everything stops mid-air and the sound drops to digital zero; only a screen can stop time like this.
native_moves.fits: a security breach caught; a failed deploy; the second before "send".

native_moves.name: Light reveal
native_moves.does: A soft band sweeps across and only lit pixels turn on (soft front, glint ≤ 20 %, ≤ ~1.3 s so nothing stays dark).
native_moves.fits: a redesign; a new pricing page; an API console.

native_moves.name: Number from glyph noise
native_moves.does: Digits scramble and lock one per sixteenth note with a small bounce.
native_moves.fits: latency cut; a count of users; a price.

native_moves.name: Type streams
native_moves.does: Elements fly to their own rows along coloured curved trails, so categories read as streams.
native_moves.fits: an inbox triaged; logs routed by severity; files synced by device.

native_moves.name: Put-away
native_moves.does: The UI dismantles itself one part per beat until one element is left.
native_moves.fits: "less is more" features; offboarding; focus mode.

score.note: clean, dry tuned percussion and pads; music as a visible process
